📖 How to use

  1. Enter estimated hours and your hourly rate.
  2. Add any out-of-pocket expenses (software, travel, subcontractors).
  3. Set your profit margin percentage on top of costs.
  4. Read the recommended quote, profit amount, and effective hourly rate.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Should margin apply to expenses too?

Yes, in this tool the margin is applied to total cost (labor plus expenses), which protects you when expenses are large.

What margin should a freelancer use?

Many freelancers add 10-30% depending on risk and demand. This is a business judgment, not a rule.

How is the effective hourly rate useful?

It shows what you really earn per hour after expenses and margin, which you can compare with your target rate.
